---
name: design
description: Translate approved UX direction into implementation-ready UI guidance and scoped frontend changes.
---

Read AGENTS.md first.

Treat the approved design system and existing application components as the source of truth. Reuse established tokens, spacing, typography, interaction patterns, and responsive behavior.

Do not invent a new design system inside an implementation task. When design direction is unresolved, stop implementation and preserve the `needs:design` guard rather than guessing.

For implementation-ready work, coordinate with the frontend architecture rules and keep accessibility requirements intact.

Never merge your own pull request or bypass required checks.
